scope: All 58 original whole screenshots individually viewed and image blocks forwarded to vision; no crops, pixel measurements, device/process queries, source edits, runtime execution, or hardware claims.
phaseSummary: Initial Get Ready 3/2/1; first Hang 10 through 1; first Rest visible from 3:00 to 2:52, then 1:44 and final 4/3/3/2/1; second Hang visible 9/9/8/7/6/5/3/2/1; second Rest 3:00 through 2:40.
timerSamplingQualification: Repeated adjacent display values at 191/192 and 195/196 and the 5 to 3 change at 200/201 are retained as directly observed. Second Hang 10 and 4 were not visible in these samples; no backfilled values or precise phase-onset inference.

verificationReopens.reason: Verify both hands before reporting; both visibly present.
First output truncated by context budget; reopened and genuinely viewed after compaction.

priorEvidencePolicy: Prior invalid Pro runs, all original Evo reports, and the appended Evo hand-visibility correction remain unchanged. Human acceptance records remain unchanged.
